nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Usage guide for the @gritty-lots/ui Vue 3 component library covering plugin vs named imports, color-mode and theme composables, cn/buttonVariants helpers, and playground development.

nodes.name: components.json
nodes.summary: shadcn-vue CLI config for the UI package: New York style, Inter font, Tailwind CSS at src/style.css with CSS variables, Remix Icon, and @/ path aliases.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite playground HTML shell that mounts #app and loads src/main.ts as an ES module for local UI component development.
nodes.languageNotes: Minimal Vite index.html; script type=module points at /src/main.ts.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Private ESM workspace package for @gritty-lots/ui, exporting the library, doc barrel, cn utils, and style.css, with Vite playground scripts and Vue 3 as a peer dependency.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for UI package sources with @/* aliases into src, Vite client types, and Vue DOM tsconfig inheritance.
nodes.languageNotes: Extends @vue/tsconfig/tsconfig.dom.json; maps @/* to ./src/* and includes Vue SFCs.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Solution-style TypeScript project that references the app and Node/Vite configs and shares @/* path aliases without compiling files itself.
nodes.languageNotes: Empty files array with references to tsconfig.app.json and tsconfig.node.json.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the UI package Vite config using NodeNext modules, noEmit, and unused-locals linting.
nodes.languageNotes: module nodenext with allowImportingTsExtensions and verbatimModuleSyntax for vite.config.ts.
